YMCA breaks ground on new swimming pool

By Newsroom
●
Around Town
●
November 17, 2026

The Waltham YMCA broke ground last week on a $3 million outdoor swimming pool project funded by the YMCA of Greater Boston. The updated facility will feature six swimming lanes, heated water, water slides, an interactive splash pad and an accessible sloped pool entry. The expected completion date is mid-June 2027.
